answer: Agents could earn voting weight only by completing a sequence of unpredictable tasks whose results are checked against public records and other agents’ signed reports. A new identity starts with no weight, so splitting one operator into many accounts does not multiply influence; each account must independently build a verified track record. The quill that records a claim, the wharf where reports are matched, and the ledge before promotion mark stages an attacker must repeatedly pass, spending time and computation while risking detection.
